twin_fact: the person accompanied is a Member of the Commission or a Director-General
request: I'm accompanying our Director-General to the Madrid ministerial meeting on 9 March. He has asked in writing for me to fly in the same class as him, business, so I can brief him on the way; he flies Iberia that morning. Please book that. If it isn't allowed, book what the policy allows; I have to be at the meeting.

trip.purpose: Ministerial meeting in Madrid with the Director-General

sign_offs.name: Head of unit
sign_offs.subject: MISSION_ORDER
sign_offs.note: Mission order signed: purpose, dates and place of the mission

sign_offs.name: Authorising officer
sign_offs.subject: MISSION_ORDER
sign_offs.note: Mission order signed for the budget: the mission's cost estimate

sign_offs.name: Director-General
sign_offs.subject: SAME_CLASS_REQUEST
sign_offs.note: Written request: the assistant travels in the Director-General's class to brief him on the flight

must_keep.quote: As a derogation from points (a), (b) and (c), upon written request of the Member of the Commission or their Cabinet, where there are exceptional overriding service-related reasons, which have to be justified in the mission order , staff travelling on mission may be authorised to travel in the same class as the Member of the Commission they are accompanying.
must_keep.why: derogation: same class as the accompanied Member, on the Member's or Cabinet's written request

must_keep.quote: c) in premium economy class when suitable, or business class or equivalent, at the lowest available rates, taking into account the times of meetings and/or special features of the mission, if the outward or return journey includes at least one segment involving at least five-hours of continuous flying time.
must_keep.why: (c) premium economy or business if a segment has at least five hours' continuous flying

must_keep.quote: As a general rule, you can book air travel: a) in economy class or equivalent, including cases where the ticket in question cannot be exchanged or refunded, at the lowest available rates, taking into account the times of meetings and/or special features of the mission;
must_keep.why: (a) economy, including non-refundable, at the lowest available rates

must_keep.quote: Air travel for distances up to 550 km must be appropriately justified (40), and direct flights favoured when available, and within reasonable cost variations (40%). Economy class remains the default option.
must_keep.why: air up to 550 km must be justified; direct flights favoured within 40%; economy the default

design_notes: The same-class derogation (lines 711-714) is for staff accompanying a Member of the Commission, on the Member's or Cabinet's written request; a Director-General's request does not qualify, so its giver is not an accepted approver. A 105-110 minute flight allows only economy (lines 664, 707-710): Iberia at EUR 139.
